passage:
The lights in Room 802 stopped working during the first class of the day. The sky was cloudy, and the room was darker than usual.
The teacher could have moved the class, but the next room was being used. So she opened the curtains and asked students to move their desks closer to the windows.
The lesson became slower. Students had to listen more carefully because the teacher could not use the screen. She drew simple pictures on paper and passed them around.
At the end of class, many students said they understood the lesson better than usual. Without bright screens, they had paid more attention.
The broken lights were fixed before lunch, but the teacher decided to use less screen time in future classes.
